where: 13.2, 'qu'on dénotera par X̂ et appelera le complété formel'
note: Spelling error of the print (appeler → appellera). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: first paragraph, 'à un voisinage ouvert arbitraire U de S'
note: A neighbourhood of the point s is meant (cf. 'voisinage ouvert U variable de s' in 13.2.1). The TeX keeps the printed capital S.

where: exact sequence after 'Considérons en effet la suite exacte'
note: The sequence analogous to (13.1.3) ends in 0. The print shows C and the TeX keeps it. If the glyph is only a badly struck O, change C to 0 in the TeX instead.

where: '(où E_s et E'_s sont les O_s-modules libres'
note: The underline marking the module is omitted; compare \underline{E}_s just before and \underline{E}'_s in the displays. The TeX keeps the print.

where: 'fibres en s des O_s-Modules E, E''
note: The Modules E, E' on S are O_S-Modules; O_s is the local ring. The TeX keeps the printed small s.

where: Corollaire 13.2.2, 'les conditions a), b), c) de 13.2.2'
note: The conditions a), b), c) are those of Lemme 13.2.1; as printed, the corollary cites itself. The TeX keeps the printed number.

where: 13.3, 'Supposons donné A comme dans 13.1, avec A = A_o'
scan: A = A_o (o set low, as an index)
note: This is condition a) of 13.2.1. A_o denotes the fibre at s (cf. A_s = A_o on p. 490). The TeX keeps the printed index.

where: 13.3, 'et considérons R_o = R_3, qui est un Z-module'
note: The fibre of R at s is meant (cf. 'R_s = R_o' on p. 488). The print shows a 3 as index and the TeX keeps it. If the glyph is a damaged s, change R_3 to R_s in the TeX instead.

where: 'toute section de O_S dont le germe en s est nul soit nul'
note: The adjective should agree with 'toute section'. The TeX keeps the print.
